sources.summary: Contemporary interpretations of traditional UK homes feature in our latest roundup, which gathers six British houses derived from their neighbours. As a result of strict UK planning laws, new residential proposals are often required to fit into the existing local context – dictating design elements from overall style and materiality to details like roof pitch The post Six British houses that put a contemporary spin on their neighbours appeared first on Dezeen .
